mcqs.learning_point: Difference between an object and its material
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly shows the difference between an object and the material it is made of?

options.A: A chair is an object; wood is the material from which it is made.
options.B: Wood is an object; a chair is the material that makes up wood.
options.C: A chair and wood are both objects, so there is no difference.
options.D: Wood is the object and the chair is the material.

mcqs.answer: A chair is an object; wood is the material from which it is made.
mcqs.explanation: The chair is the finished item we use – that is the object. Wood is the substance that forms the chair – that is the material. Options B, C and D reverse or confuse the two terms, which is why they are incorrect.

mcqs.learning_point: Different objects made from the same material
mcqs.question: All of the following pairs are made from the same material except one. Which pair is different?
mcqs.explanation: The water bottle, toy car, spoon, cup, window, and bottle are all made of plastic or glass respectively, so they share the same material. A wooden table is made of wood while a metal chair is made of metal, so they are not made from the same material. Hence option D is the exception.

mcqs.learning_point: Same object types made from different materials
mcqs.question: Which statement correctly clears the common misconception that all chairs are made of wood?

options.A: All chairs are made only of wood because wood is the strongest material.
options.B: Chairs can be made of wood, plastic, or metal, depending on their design and use.
options.C: Only plastic chairs exist; wood cannot be used for chairs.
options.D: Metal chairs are actually wooden chairs painted with metal color.

mcqs.answer: Chairs can be made of wood, plastic, or metal, depending on their design and use.
mcqs.explanation: Chairs are manufactured from many materials – wood, plastic, metal, and even composite materials – based on required strength, cost, and appearance. Options A, C, and D are false statements that perpetuate misconceptions.

mcqs.learning_point: Choosing materials according to their properties
mcqs.question: A cooking pot needs to be strong, conduct heat well, and resist corrosion. Which material is the best choice?
mcqs.explanation: Iron is strong, conducts heat efficiently, and can be treated to resist corrosion, making it ideal for cooking pots. Wood and plastic are poor conductors and would warp or melt, while glass can break under heat stress.

mcqs.learning_point: Difference between an object and its material
mcqs.question: Select the pair that correctly matches an object with the material it is made from.
mcqs.explanation: In option A, the cup is the finished item (object) and glass is the substance it is made from (material). Options B, C, and D reverse the relationship or mislabel the terms, so they are incorrect.

mcqs.learning_point: Different objects made from the same material
mcqs.question:
In a competitive exam, you are asked: Which set of objects are all made from the same material?
A) Water bottle, plastic spoon, toy car
B) Wooden chair, metal table, glass jar
C) Cotton shirt, silk scarf, wool sweater
D) Iron nail, wooden stick, plastic bag

options.A: Water bottle, plastic spoon, toy car
options.B: Wooden chair, metal table, glass jar
options.C: Cotton shirt, silk scarf, wool sweater
options.D: Iron nail, wooden stick, plastic bag

mcqs.answer: Water bottle, plastic spoon, toy car
mcqs.explanation: All three items in option A are typically manufactured from plastic, so they share the same material. The other options each contain items made from different materials (wood, metal, glass; cotton, silk, wool; iron, wood, plastic).

mcqs.learning_point: Same object types made from different materials
mcqs.question: Which statement is true about chairs?

options.A: A chair can be made only of wood.
options.B: A chair can be made of wood, plastic, or metal.
options.C: A chair must be made of metal to be strong.
options.D: A chair is always made of glass.

mcqs.answer: A chair can be made of wood, plastic, or metal.
mcqs.explanation: Chairs are produced from various materials such as wood, plastic, and metal, depending on design, cost, and purpose. Options A, C, and D limit chairs to a single material, which is incorrect.

mcqs.learning_point: Choosing materials according to their properties
mcqs.question: Why is metal a good material for making a kitchen spoon?

options.A: Metal is heavy and melts easily, making it easy to shape.
options.B: Metal is strong, does not break easily, and conducts heat well.
options.C: Metal is transparent, so you can see the food inside.
options.D: Metal is soft and can be chewed safely.

mcqs.answer: Metal is strong, does not break easily, and conducts heat well.
mcqs.explanation: Metal's strength and durability prevent the spoon from breaking during use, and its good heat conductivity allows it to warm up quickly when stirring hot food. Options A, C, and D describe properties that are not true for typical kitchen metals.
